authorization: Owner directed continuation of all remaining proof-DAG units. This unit composes already accepted M01, M04, and C02 statements without reading their proofs as author inputs.
space: E=R^2 with the standard Euclidean norm; D(s) is an arbitrary real continuous linear map E->E and ||.||op is the induced Euclidean operator norm.

definitions.f_K(s): s for K=0; sinh(sqrt(K)s)/sqrt(K) for K>0
definitions.dA(s): the positive real square root of det(D(s)), only after det(D(s))>0 is derived

accepted_dependencies.statement: For the admitted Jacobi system, ||D(s)-s Id||op<=f_K(s)-s.
accepted_dependencies.admission_gate: M04 must obtain observed CAS_4AXIS_PASS and independent review before M05 publication.

accepted_dependencies.statement: For arbitrary real 2x2 D, s>0, 0<=eta<1 and ||D-s Id||op<=s eta, both singular values lie in [s(1-eta),s(1+eta)], det(D)>0, and the positive sqrt(det(D)) lies in the same interval.

boundary_controls: K=0 gives eta_K(s)=0, D(s)=s Id from M04, det(D)=s^2>0, and dA=s.
eta_K(s)=1 is excluded by the supplied eta_K(L)<1 domain and M01; no caustic conclusion is drawn at eta=1.
No symmetry, normality, definiteness, diagonalizability, or commuting curvature assumption is added.
excluded: redshift Taylor remainder and FD2/FD3 rerun
physical screen-transport existence beyond M04 premises
full theorem, observation, inference, or scientific admission
